name: Denalan
summary: At Lake Al'Ameth, Denalan studies Teldrassil's unusual plants and seeks remedies for its corruption. He tends a small lakeside plot and asks young adventurers to gather samples, examine timberlings, and test enchanted soil.

sections.title: A Botanist at Lake Al'Ameth
sections.body: Denalan studies plants on Lake Al'Ameth's eastern shore. He works beneath a cloth awning, with field tools and rows of planter boxes close at hand. While many kaldorei focus on martial vigilance or high druidic rites, he gives his days to herbalism. He chooses this plot over Darnassus's grand barrows, so he can examine the unusual flora that has grown since the new World Tree was planted.

sections.title: Investigating Teldrassil's Blemishes
sections.body: Denalan investigates the growing unrest among Teldrassil's native wildlife. Timberlings, usually docile woodland beings of wood and sprout, have grown increasingly aggressive. He enchants soil to nurture wild seeds in captivity and study how corruption seeps into root systems. Shimmering fronds, glowing fruit, and moss-twined growths are among the specimens he examines as he seeks the taint troubling the forest boughs.

faq.answer: Find Denalan on Lake Al'Ameth's eastern bank in southern Teldrassil, south of Dolanaar. His small camp, with an awning and cultivated planting beds, lies near the water's edge.

faq.q: What is Denalan researching at his campsite?
aliases: why is denalan at the lake
faq.answer: Denalan studies Teldrassil's unusual flora and the aggressive behavior of local woodland spirits. He uses enchanted planter boxes to grow timberling seeds and examine curious specimens as he seeks ways to cleanse corruption from the new World Tree's ecosystem.

faq.q: Why are the timberlings attacking people?
faq.answer: Timberlings are plant-like nature spirits native to Teldrassil's boughs. Usually peaceful, they have grown violent and erratic as unnatural corruption spreads through the World Tree's soil and roots. Researchers like Denalan study their seeds to understand the change.

faq.q: What are Denalan's planter boxes used for?
faq.answer: Denalan uses specially prepared beds filled with enchanted earth to cultivate wild seeds and strange botanical cuttings. They let him observe how forest plants react to purified soil away from wild contaminants.
Denalan works with Rellian Greenspyre, a druid in Darnassus who shares his interest in timberlings. A colleague in Dolanaar also sends him rare earth from Darnassus.

faq.q: What is the Moss-twined Heart that Denalan examines?
faq.answer: The Moss-twined Heart is a blighted botanical core recovered from Blackmoss the Fetid, a corrupted timberling in Teldrassil. Denalan studies it in enchanted soil to understand the unnatural sickness twisting the island's plant life.

angles.text: As an herbalist, you follow the kaldorei tradition of botanical study. Gathering and cultivating wild plants can help reveal deeper ailments in the natural world.
As a druid, you may find common cause with Denalan's lakeside experiments. His work helps the Cenarion Circle trace and purge the taint spreading through Teldrassil's roots.
As a night elf, you share the early kaldorei effort to understand the unexpected flaws and growing pains of your new home, Teldrassil.
